vw_template_table_based.description: Reference template for a table-based analytical view with projection and row filtering.

vw_template_query_based.description: Reference template for a persistent query-based view across Gold analytical marts.
vw_template_query_based.query: SELECT customer_id, total_revenue, total_orders FROM {catalog}.{gold_schema}.gold_customer_sales_mart WHERE total_revenue >= 1000.0
